title: Vibrant Crunchy Tunisian Chicken Tagine
description: A nutty and crunchy Tunisian dish featuring pine nuts, perfect for a date night, and can be made nut-free friendly, served in a bento box.

ingredients.name: pine nuts
ingredients.notes: or substitute with sunflower seeds for nut-free option

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken breast with salt, black pepper, and spices.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken breast until browned on both sides.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the pine nuts to the skillet and cook until lightly toasted.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and deglaze, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Add the pitted dates to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken breast to the skillet and spoon some of the sauce over the top.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
